Kp-VirTracer requires an existing virulence BLAST nucleotide database.

## 1) Build virulence BLAST DB (required)

```bash
makeblastdb -in /path/to/virulence_genes.fasta -dbtype nucl -out /path/to/db/virulence_db
```

Use the BLAST DB prefix (`/path/to/db/virulence_db`) as runtime input.
Do not pass a FASTA path to `--virulence-db`.

## 2) Run Kp-VirTracer

```bash
Rscript run_kpvirtracer.R \
  --input /path/to/fasta_dir \
  --output /path/to/output_dir \
  --virulence-db /path/to/db/virulence_db \
  --threads 8
```
